label: CORRECT
definition: next two reported quarters improve/confirm revenue and EPS without a fourth-quarter reversal

label: TOO_EARLY
definition: confirmation appears only after the first future quarter

label: TOO_LATE
definition: revenue and EPS were already positive in both prior observations when TURNING_UP fired

label: FALSE_RECOVERY
definition: future revenue/EPS do not confirm, or reverse by the fourth future quarter
